steps.title: locate vlabench entity · open vlabench gripper · move vlabench ee to
steps.code:
def ee_try(yaw):
    r=primitives.call(name='locate_vlabench_entity', entity_name='salad_dressing')
    h=r.output['evidence_handle']; p=r.output['entity']['world_target']
    print('target', [round(v,3) for v in p], 'yaw', yaw)
    primitives.call(name='open_vlabench_gripper', horizon=20)
    m1=primitives.call(name='move_vlabench_ee_to', evidence_handles=[h], target_position=[p[0],p[1],p[2]+0.15], target_euler=[3.14159,0.0,yaw], gripper_state=0.04, horizon=60)
    m2=primitives.call(name='move_vlabench_ee_to', evidence_handles=[h], target_position=[p[0],p[1],p[2]+0.005], target_euler=[3.14159,0.0,yaw], gripper_state=0.04, horizon=60)
    print('moves', m1.ok, m2.ok, str(m2.output)[:200] if not m2.ok else '')
    c=primitives.call(name='close_vlabench_gripper', horizon=40)
    o=primitives.call(name='observe_vlabench_scene', query='grasped')
    s=str(o.output); i=s.find('grasped_obj_name'); print(s[i:i+80])
    return 'salad_dressing' in s[i:i+80], h
ok,h=ee_try(0.0)
print('grasped', ok)

def sd_pose():
    o=primitives.call(name='observe_vlabench_scene', query='salad_dressing pose')
    s=str(o.output); i=s.find("'salad_dressing': {"); j=s.find("'xpos'",i); return s[j:j+200]
base=[dp[0],dp[1],dp[2]+0.25]
for eul in ([3.14159,0.8,0.0],[3.14159,1.3,0.0]):
    m=primitives.call(name='move_vlabench_ee_to', evidence_handles=[dh], target_position=base, target_euler=eul, gripper_state=0.0, horizon=60)
    print(eul, m.ok, '' if m.ok else str(m.output)[:200])
    print(sd_pose())
